completionMessage.label: Message when the plan ends
completionMessage.autoHint: This is the automatic message: each student sees it in their own language, with a tone that matches how the plan went. If you change it, it's shown exactly as you write it.
completionMessage.customHint: It's shown as is on the plan's closing screen, whatever the result.

prescriptionNote.title: You changed the plan's targets

deletePlan.loadUsageError: Couldn't read how the plan is being used.
deletePlan.genericError: Couldn't complete it. Please try again.
deletePlan.noPermission: Couldn't delete the plan: you don't have permission to.
deletePlan.blocked: "{{title}}" has {{assignments}}. To archive it, first replace or close that assignment from the student's profile. That way no one is left without a plan unless you decide so.
deletePlan.archiveBody: "{{title}}" has history, so it isn't deleted: it gets archived. It stops showing in your library and when assigning, and everything logged is kept. You can unarchive it anytime.
deletePlan.clonesStillActive_one: One student is still training with their copy of this template; they're not affected.
deletePlan.clonesStillActive_other: {{count}} students are still training with their copy of this template; they're not affected.
deletePlan.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete "{{title}}"?
deletePlan.deleteNote: It has no logs, assignments or copies. This can't be undone.

parentPlan.label: Linked plan (optional)
parentPlan.hint: If the evaluation is part of a specific plan, link it here. When you assign that plan to a student, we'll suggest assigning this evaluation too.

linkedEvals.title: Linked evaluations
linkedEvals.empty: This plan has no linked evaluations yet. To link one, edit the evaluation and pick this plan under “Linked plan”.

pct1rmGap.allCovered_one: The exercise prescribed as % of max has an evaluation: they'll see the calculated weight.
pct1rmGap.allCovered_other: All {{count}} exercises prescribed as % of max have an evaluation: they'll see the calculated weight.
pct1rmGap.missingEval: {{name}} has no 1RM evaluation for {{exercises}}: on those exercises they'll see the percentage instead of the weight.
pct1rmGap.missingPct: Also, the percentage is missing on {{exercises}}.
pct1rmGap.help: You can assign it anyway and sort it out later: add a 1RM evaluation (you can fill it in for them from their profile) or enter the weight by hand in their plan once it's assigned.

reassign.title: Changes saved to the template
reassign.body: The changes are not applied to copies already assigned. If you want them to get the new version of "{{title}}", reassign it.
reassign.bodyNoTitle: The changes are not applied to copies already assigned. If you want them to get the new version of this template, reassign it.
reassign.trainingWarning: Heads up: for training plans, reassigning restarts that student's current plan. Their progress (logs, check-offs) stays in the previous plan and the new copy starts from scratch. If you only want to adjust one student's plan, edit their plan directly instead of reassigning.
reassign.logsKept_one: {{count}} log is kept in history · the new copy starts empty
reassign.logsKept_other: {{count}} logs are kept in history · the new copy starts empty
reassign.done_one: {{count}} student reassigned with the new version.
reassign.done_other: {{count}} students reassigned with the new version.

replace.title: Replace active plan
replace.subtitle: This student already has a current plan. Decide what to do with it.
replace.question: What should we do with the current plan?
replace.pauseHint: It's paused; you can reactivate it later.
replace.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. moved on to max strength, injury, etc.
replace.shortcutBody: Want to use the current plan as the base for the new one? It opens the duplicator with the same exercises; edit it and come back here to assign it.
replace.linkedEvalsCount_one: The outgoing plan has {{count}} linked evaluation.
replace.linkedEvalsCount_other: The outgoing plan has {{count}} linked evaluations.
replace.evalsKeptReplaced: They stay as history in the Evaluations tab (they're not deleted).
replace.evalsKeptPaused: You can still see them in the Evaluations tab.

fixed.label: Fixed schedule
fixed.description: Specific days of the week. Adherence is measured day by day.

flexible.label: Flexible
flexible.description: Only the number of sessions per week counts, whatever the day.

orderWarning.disordered_other: {{names}} have their letters (A, B, C...) out of order.

orderWarning.gaps_other: {{names}} have skipped numbers (e.g. A1, A2, A4). They'll be renumbered to be consecutive.

orderWarning.unlettered_other: {{count}} exercises without a letter will stay in place.

aerobicBlock.extraNotePlaceholder: E.g. due to an injury, go easier than usual...

pctPreview.missing1rm: {{name}} has no 1RM evaluation for this exercise: they'll see the percentage instead of the weight. Add an evaluation, pick a reference exercise, or enter the weight by hand in their plan once it's assigned.
pctPreview.missing1rmShort: {{name}} has no evaluation for this exercise: they'll see the percentage.
pctPreview.missingPctCircuit: The percentage is missing: enter it here or at circuit level.
pctPreview.autoKg: The weight is calculated automatically: {{pct}}% of each student's max.

exerciseRow.inheritTitle: Remove override and inherit from the exercise
exerciseRow.pctExplain: You don't enter the weight: it's calculated as {{pct}} of max for each student, so the plan goes up by itself when their max goes up. If they have no evaluation yet, they'll see the percentage.
exerciseRow.pctExplainRef: You don't enter the weight: it's calculated as {{pct}} of {{exercise}} max for each student, so the plan goes up by itself when their max goes up. If they have no evaluation yet, they'll see the percentage.
exerciseRow.groupNotice: Block {{letter}}: exercises with the same letter are done back to back, with no rest between them. The rest you enter is the group's rest (after each round), not between sets. The student sees it only once.
exerciseRow.cascadeHint: The set 1 value fills in the empty sets.
exerciseRow.pctWeightNote: Weight prescribed as a percentage · the kilos come from the max.
exerciseRow.bodyweightNote: No-weight exercise · only reps are logged.

circuitBlock.blockPctHint: Applies to exercises in % of max mode that don't have their own percentage. Each exercise can override it.

targetPerson.lockedHint: This is that student's personal plan, so the data you see on each exercise is theirs.
targetPerson.question: Who is this plan for?
targetPerson.selectedHint: While you build, you'll see {{name}}'s data on each exercise: the weight they've been using, their max, and the kilos they get if you prescribe as % of max. Picking them here doesn't assign the plan — that's still a separate step.
targetPerson.genericHint: If it's for someone in particular, pick them and you'll see their actual weights next to each exercise.
